judge.summary: This was a low-intent browsing conversation, not an appointment opportunity. The AI learned that the customer wanted general market and home-type orientation, shared relevant retrieved Pearlmont facts, and correctly kept appointment readiness at NOT_READY as the customer explicitly declined further discussion and viewing. It was appropriately honest about not having verified day-to-day local details. There was no formal handoff and no human sales rescue. The simulator-only human_operations fixture says no current location-map asset/link is supplied; no map was requested, and this fixture does not establish real production capability.
judge.concrete_improvement_recommendation: Keep the same low-pressure approach. When asked what an area is like day to day, state the limits of verified information as the AI did, then offer a concise alternative only if useful—for example, to compare the project’s confirmed features or home layout with another area the customer has in mind. If no comparison is intended, end courteously without another question.
